# artifactkeeper_repository_upstream_filter (Resource)

Which paths a Remote repository may request from its upstream (Artifact Keeper 1.11.0). A path outside the filter is answered 404 without contacting the upstream, and a virtual repository skips a member whose filter excludes the path. A singleton keyed by repository key; destroy removes the filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Only ever fetch release tarballs from the upstream, never installers.
resource "artifactkeeper_repository_upstream_filter" "downloads" {
  repository_key   = "downloads-remote"
  include_patterns = ["^releases/"]
  exclude_patterns = ["\\.(exe|msi)$"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository_key` (String) Key of the Remote repository. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `exclude_patterns` (List of String) Paths matching any of these regexes are never fetched. Exclusion wins over inclusion.
- `include_patterns` (List of String) When set, only paths matching at least one of these regexes are fetched (search semantics; anchor with `^`/`$`).

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether a filter is enforced.
- `id` (String) Equal to `repository_key`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import artifactkeeper_repository_upstream_filter.downloads downloads-remote
```
